name: Validator incentives

subjectOf.text: The final 2021 Casper testnet used perceived validator node uptime as its single rewarding requirement.
subjectOf.abstract: The latest incentivized testnet ended in September 2021. The last Casper tesnet in September 2021 entailed as its single rewarding requirement the perceived uptime of the participating testnet validator node.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hybrid Secure Proof of Stake (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3931933
scope_conditions: Casper testnet incentivization phase ending September 2021

subjectOf.text: Slashing establishes a Nash equilibrium in which rational validators adhere to honest behavior, because the expected cost of penalties exceeds any short-term gain available from misconduct.
subjectOf.abstract: game-theoretic models, which demonstrate that slashing establishes a Nash equilibrium wherein rational validators are incentivized to adhere to honest behavior, as the expected cost of penalties outweighs any potential short-term gains from misconduct
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296
scope_conditions: assumes rational validators who value long-term participation rewards

subjectOf.text: Validators who align with the stake weighted consensus ranking gain reputation and those who deviate lose it, which carries the winner takes losers' stakes property of the original framework over to ranked voting.
subjectOf.abstract: Validators who align with consensus gain reputation. Those who deviate lose it. Thus, preserving the winner-takes-losers'-stakes property from the original framework (Calcaterra, Kaal, and Andrei 2018, 7) while extending it to ranked voting.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998
scope_conditions: validator agreement measured by normalized Kendall tau distance from consensus

subjectOf.text: Honest ranking strictly dominates strategic ranking for validators whenever the reputation gain from consensus alignment matters, so truth telling is a Bayesian Nash equilibrium.
subjectOf.abstract: Honest voting strictly dominates strategic voting when reputation gain matters.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998
